Cookie Policy

Draft prepared 12 October 2026 · Review before publishing

What cookies are

Cookies and similar technologies may be used by websites to remember settings, operate essential features, protect services or measure use.

What this website currently uses

This policy must be checked against the actual live website and hosting configuration before publication. The supplied static Services & Prices files do not by themselves establish whether the host, embedded widgets or analytics services set cookies or access device information.

Essential technologies

Some strictly necessary technologies may operate without consent where the legal exemption applies. Visitors should still receive clear information about them.

Analytics, advertising and embeds

If non-essential analytics, advertising, tracking pixels or embedded services are added, appropriate information and a consent mechanism must be implemented before those technologies are used, unless a valid legal exception applies. Merely publishing this page does not create cookie consent controls.

Your choices

You can manage or delete cookies in your browser settings. Where the website uses consent-based technologies, a working preference mechanism should also allow you to revisit your choice.

Questions

For cookie or privacy questions, email marnie@dorsetdivision.co.uk.
